title: ETHealthworld Nutrition and Wellness Awards celebrates India’s nutrition and wellness leaders
summary: India’s nutrition and wellness changemakers took centre stage at the third edition of the ETHealthworld Nutrition and Wellness Awards 2026, as leading brands, organisations and professionals were recognised for their contributions to innovation and impact...

contentHtml:
New Delhi: The ETHealthworld Nutrition and Wellness Awards returned with its third edition, continuing its commitment to recognising excellence, innovation and impact across India’s evolving nutrition and wellness landscape. As growing awareness, scientific advancements and changing consumer needs reshaped the industry, the awards celebrated the individuals, organisations, products and initiatives that were driving meaningful change in health and well-being.

From innovative nutrition products and evidence-based wellness solutions to pioneering initiatives and visionary leadership, the awards honoured those setting new benchmarks in quality, innovation, accessibility and impact.

Advt

The event brought together leading voices and changemakers from across the ecosystem who were not only advancing the science and practice of nutrition and wellness but also shaping healthier lifestyles and contributing to the well-being of individuals and communities across India.

The third edition drew a strong response, with nominations received across 39 categories spanning AI and digital innovation, nutrition and wellness products, marketing campaigns and initiatives, individual excellence, and special recognitions for brands, start-ups, wellness centres and spas.The entries underwent a rigorous multi-stage evaluation, beginning with assessment by Knowledge Partner EY. A two-tier judging process then narrowed the field, with the top five entries in each category advancing to the final shortlist.

The final decision rested with the Grand Jury, a panel of senior nutrition, public health and food safety experts who selected the ultimate winners from the shortlisted entries. The Grand Jury comprised Sheela Krishnaswamy, Past President, Indian Dietetic Association, Dr Seema Puri, Former Professor, Institute of Home Economics, University of Delhi, Varsha Mishra, Deputy Director, Global Food Safety and Nutrition Expert, Quality Council of India, Anuja Agarwala, National Vice President, Indian Dietetic Association, and Former Senior Dietitian, AIIMS, Dr Mansi Chopra, Director, HRIDAY and Major Dr Ashlesha Tawde Kelkar, Associate Professor, Community Medicine, MGM Medical College, Mumbai.

Advt

To keep the process fair, no jury member was assigned entries within the categories pertaining to their own field of work, and a strict code of conduct ensured impartial evaluation. All submitted material remained confidential to the judges, and only the credits and case study section of each entry was made public through the shortlist and winner announcements.

The winners were unveiled and celebrated at the awards ceremony held on 27 November 2026 at The Leela Ambience, Gurugram.The winners of the ETHealthworld Nutrition and Wellness Awards 2026 are:

  • AI Innovation in Wellness of the Year: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited
  • Consumer Engagement Initiative of the Year: Nestlé Ceregrow – ‘Beat the Dhak’ Activation
  • Digital Marketing Campaign of the Year: Himalaya Wellness Company – India's Stress Check
  • Health Awareness Campaign of the Year: Himalaya Wellness Company – India's Stress Check
  • Sustainable Nutrition Initiative of the Year: Natural Remedies Pvt. Ltd.
  • Excellence in Ayurvedic Medicine: CLEVIRA
  • Excellence in Clinical Nutrition: Jolly Healthcare
  • Excellence in Nutritional Supplements: Ace Blend
  • Hair Care Product of the Year: Mosaic Wellness (Man Matters)
  • Maternal & Child Nutrition Product of the Year: ITC Limited
  • Emerging Nutrition and Wellness Brand of the Year: Keystone NeoGreens
  • Excellence in Workplace Nutrition & Wellness: Reliance Jio Infocomm Limited
  • Farm-to-Table Brand of the Year: Sri Sathya Sai Annapoorna Trust
  • Health & Wellness Start-up of the Year: Keystone NeoGreens
  • Health and Wellness Solution of the Year: Mosaic Wellness (Man Matters)
  • Nutrition and Wellness Brand of the Year: Wellbeing Nutrition
  • Wellness/Fitness Centre of the Year: Maharishi Ayurveda Boutique Wellness Retreat, Rishikesh
  • Dietician of the Year: Dr. Eileen Canday
  • Nutritionist of the Year: Dr. Anu Mahajan
  • Wellness/Fitness Guru of the Year: Dr. Rohini Somnath Patil

Jury Recognitions:

  • Wellness/Fitness Centre of the Year: Spartan Fitness, Gurgaon
  • Wellness/Fitness Guru of the Year: Dr. J.C. Balachandar (Dr. Bala)
